svg.title: Spectre Brands hybrid hA Corner Peek (textured)
svg.desc: Black VHS shell (X06 geometry) with X06 orange rental strip #F47A20 at -2 degrees and X06 Permanent Marker lettering, outlined. 20 mm asymmetric sheet head with unobstructed oval eyes, side mittens and a 32 mm peeled curl; two hands gripping the underside. Centre label recess left empty. textured version.

path.aria-label: What killed it, and what happened to its name
